Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You tell the room what your companion did, and watch people turn to look at them differently.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
A few minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
A nonhostile audience; a few minutes.
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Tell a truthful or honestly believed story about a companion. Name a plausible introduction, audience or welcome you seek.

Weak
1 progress toward that welcome.
Standard
2 progress and learn who can grant it.
Strong
3 progress and a willing listener offers to introduce you.
